skill.name: chatcrystal-task-recall
skill.description: Recall ChatCrystal project and global memories before substantial implementation, refactoring, migration, configuration, investigation, or optimization work.
skill.summary: Recall ChatCrystal memories before substantial project work.
skill.author: ZengLiangYi

security_audit.summary: All static external-command and network hits are false positives caused by markdown inline code, a fenced JSON example, and prose. The remaining concern is that the workflow sends task and repository metadata to a configured ChatCrystal MCP memory tool. No prompt injection or shell execution instructions were found.

remediation.issue: Task metadata can include sensitive repository context.
remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit consent and data-minimization step before calling `recall_for_task`; omit paths, branch names, and file lists when not needed.

remediation.issue: Full mode depends on a trusted MCP memory service.
remediation.suggestion: Document that `recall_for_task` should point to a trusted ChatCrystal Core instance and should not be auto-installed by the workflow.

static_findings.snippet: 4. If `recall_for_task` is available, call it before substantive work with:
- `task.source_agent` when the runtime has a stable value
5. Treat `project_memories` as primary context and `global_memories` as supplemental context.
Use this shape when calling `recall_for_task` for implementation or investigation work:
Full mode requires ChatCrystal Core plus MCP access to `recall_for_task`.
- Prefer the current repository or workspace path so Core can derive `project_key`.
- Surface relevant warnings such as `no-project-key` or `no-matches`, but do not treat them as failu
3. Skip trivial edits, one-line answers, or purely conversational requests.

semantic_findings.title: Task Metadata Shared With Memory Tool
semantic_findings.description: The workflow instructs the agent to call `recall_for_task` with task goals, repository paths, branch names, related files, and source agent details. This can expose sensitive project metadata to the configured ChatCrystal MCP memory service without an explicit consent step in the skill.

content.value_statement: Important project decisions are easy to miss when AI agents start substantial work. This skill recalls ChatCrystal project memories first, then uses global memories as supporting context.
actual_capabilities: Decides when a task is substantial enough for memory recall.
Calls `recall_for_task` with task goals, kind, paths, branch, and related files.
Prioritizes project memories before global memories.
Applies recalled decisions, pitfalls, and patterns before coding.
Continues normally when ChatCrystal Core or MCP access is unavailable.
limitations: Requires ChatCrystal Core and MCP access for full recall.
Does not create or manage a separate memory system.
May return no useful memories for new projects or sparse histories.
Can expose task metadata to the configured memory service.

use_cases.title: Prepare Project Changes
use_cases.description: Review prior project decisions before implementing features, migrations, or refactors.

use_cases.title: Guide AI Coding Sessions
use_cases.description: Give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code relevant context before non-trivial repository work.

use_cases.title: Reduce Repeated Mistakes
use_cases.description: Surface known pitfalls and reusable patterns before teams repeat similar work.

prompt_templates.title: Recall Before Coding
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $chatcrystal-task-recall before implementing this feature. Summarize relevant project memories before changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate With Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $chatcrystal-task-recall for this bug investigation. Include the current repository path, branch, and suspected files if available.
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigating behavior in an existing project.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $chatcrystal-task-recall for this migration plan. Retrieve project memories first, compare global memories, then list decisions that affect the migration.
prompt_templates.scenario: Planning a risky schema or configuration migration.

prompt_templates.title: Audit A Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $chatcrystal-task-recall before refactoring this module. Recall prior pitfalls, related files, and reusable patterns, then apply them to the implementation plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preparing a broad refactor across related files.

output_examples.input: User asks Codex to add a paginated notes export endpoint.
output_examples.output: The assistant recalls project memories, notes prior pagination rules, warns about export limits, then starts implementation with that context.

output_examples.input: User asks Claude Code to investigate a failing migration.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks ChatCrystal memories, surfaces a prior migration pitfall, and uses it to guide the investigation.

output_examples.input: User asks for a one-line wording change.
output_examples.output: The assistant skips recall because the task is trivial and proceeds normally.

best_practices: Use recall for substantial implementation, refactoring, migration, configuration, investigation, or optimization work.
Treat project memories as primary and global memories as supplemental.
State clearly when memory recall is unavailable or returns no useful matches.
anti_patterns: Do not use recall for trivial edits or purely conversational requests.
Do not invent recalled memories when the MCP tool is unavailable.
Do not auto-install ChatCrystal Core as part of this workflow.

faq.question: Does this skill require ChatCrystal Core?
faq.answer: Yes. Full mode needs ChatCrystal Core and MCP access to `recall_for_task`.

faq.question: What happens if the recall tool is unavailable?
faq.answer: The assistant continues normally and says that long-term recall is unavailable.

faq.question: Does it change project files by itself?
faq.answer: No. It only guides when and how to recall memory before work.

faq.question: Which memories are prioritized?
faq.answer: Project memories are primary. Global memories are used only as supporting context.

faq.question: Can it be used with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data may be sent to recall?
faq.answer: Task goals, repository paths, branch names, and related file names may be included.
